mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate above 5.0% compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals tight labor market conditions that boost corporate profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in real consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust aggregate demand, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of RSAFS growth and HOUST growth fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 100 signals manufacturing contraction, triggering recession fears and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real consumer spending above its 12-month moving average compresses equity risk premiums, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI inflation rate above 4.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting restrictive monetary policy and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 4.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 100 signals manufacturing slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to recessionary pressures.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained non-farm payrolls growth above 200,000 monthly adds signals strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 200,000 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).
